rules.statement: The dismissal of a partition action determines the title of the defendant as against the plaintiff, and this determination is res judicata in subsequent actions between the same parties.
rules.supporting_quote: In the present case after the two parties had filed their pleadings and after the trial had been fixed the 3rd defendant expressly invited the Court upon a named contingency to adjudicate on his claim without evidence. I do not think he can now be heard to say that there was no investigation of the dispute between him and the 5th defendant.

meta.parties: Sedarahamy Et Al. v. Abubucker Et Al
